paint_reflect.rule: Emissive += Fresnel(N.V; F0 = lerp(0.08 Specular, BaseColor, Metallic), coat F0 0.04) x (1 - roughness / 0.5)^2 x baked sky strip(reflect(V, N leaned by the rivulets)) x PaintEnvGain x PaintEnvTint x PaintEnvAmount; the gain is the canopy's (canopy_reflect, gain_rule), never 0 for an exterior panel seen from inside; UNCALIBRATED

scene_sky.rule: above the horizon: SkyAtmosphereViewLuminance(reflect(V, N)) toward the CIE overcast sky Lz (1 + 2 sin e) / 3 by cloud cover; below: ground x exp(-tau / |r.z|) + the Sky View LUT's in-scatter; horizon blur smoothstep(-2 alpha, 2 alpha, r.z); x 0.5 (0.10 / 0.2, the strip path's level); the strip per pixel where the LUT is not drawn (aircraft_scene_sky.py; UNCALIBRATED)
scene_sky.ground_source: the sky light's lower hemisphere x its colour x intensity (hero lighting: albedo x E / pi)
scene_sky.tau_source: the scene's SkyAtmosphere (Rayleigh + Mie exponential columns below the aircraft)

contrail.formation_ramp_basis: round 47: the trail forms over contrail.FormationRampS after FormationDelayS (FormationRamp = FormationRampS / LifetimeS); -contrail-formation-ramp=off is the A/B
contrail.rule: drawn while atmosphere/T-R is below contrail.MaxTemperatureK and position/h-sl-meters above contrail.MinAltitudeM (Schmidt-Appleman threshold, no humidity modelled); wingtip vapour from the humidity test (aircraft_look.condensation), or while accelerations/Nz exceeds vapour.MinNz when the humidity is unavailable; vapour_frames counts only the frames these wingtip vapour trails drew (the humidity-gated tip ribbons' frames are in aircraft_look.condensation.per_frame)
contrail.in_cloud: a contrail's opacity x (1 - cover) of every cloud layer the aircraft is inside (base..top above the ground datum); contrail_in_cloud_frames counts them
contrail.label_convention: a trail is a translucent medium like the clouds and rain the label captures already omit: where it crosses in front of the aircraft the mask still says aircraft
contrail.width_model: width(age) = StartWidthM + JetSpreadM x (1 - exp(-age / JetMixS)) + SpreadMPerS x age (the jet regime's saturating spread, then slow diffusion; twin aircraft_look.contrail_width_m); UNCALIBRATED
contrail.wake_rollup: each engine plume is drawn to its side's wingtip vortex core (+/- VortexSpanFraction x the 17.0 m semi-span from the nav lamps) over VortexRollupS and the pair sinks at WakeSinkMPerS (twin aircraft_look.contrail_wake_offset_m); UNCALIBRATED
contrail.facing: LOOK_GENERATION 15: one camera-facing ribbon (contrail_facing.hlsl World Position Offset turns strip 0 about the axis to across = cross(a, v), strip 1 folds onto the axis), the chord profile across and the tube's world normal (contrail_normal.hlsl): a circular tube from any azimuth, sun side lit, far side sky-lit; -contrail-facing=off is the A/B. Twins aircraft_look.contrail_facing_offset, contrail_tube_normal
contrail.view_weight: LOOK_GENERATION 14: each strip of the crossed ribbon x (n.v)^2 / (1 - (a.v)^2) (n its plane normal, a the axis on UV1/UV2, v CameraVectorWS); the two sum to 1 at every view, as a cylinder's projection is the same from every azimuth; -contrail-view-weight=off is the A/B. Twin aircraft_look.contrail_view_weight
contrail.puffs: contrail_opacity.hlsl: a cylinder's chord across, two octaves of world-space value noise whose cell coarsens with age, the cut rising with the sample's Life (vertex colour R = age / its own lifetime); Puff = PuffBreakup, 0 under -contrail-puffs=off (the A/B)
contrail.lighting: lit translucent, Volumetric Directional, half-cylinder normals: a sun side and a shadow side (the material build falls back to NonDirectional when the Python lacks the name; the master's property says which)

persistence.rule: RHi = RH x e_sat,water / e_sat,ice (Sonntag 1990 Magnus forms); factor = saturate((RHi - PersistenceRhiOnsetPct) / PersistenceRhiSpanPct); a sample's lifetime = LifetimeS + factor x (PersistentLifetimeS - LifetimeS), fixed at emission (the air it is in); no humidity (no dew point on the card, no -humidity-pct=): factor 0, LifetimeS. Twin aircraft_look.contrail_persistence; UNCALIBRATED

heat_haze.switch: -heat-haze=on (off by default; never on in a measured shot)

condensation.formula: T_l = T (p_l/p)^0.2857; dq = q_v(RH,T,p) - q_sat(T_l,p_l); opacity = clamp(OpacityPerGkg x (q_v - q_sat(T_l + OnsetCoolingK, p_l))), 0 below VisibleMinGkg. tip: Gamma = Nz W/(rho V b pi/4), dp = 0.87 rho Gamma^2/(4 pi^2 rc^2), rc = CoreRadiusSpanFraction b; sheet: CL = Nz W/(qbar S), Cp_min = -(SheetCpMinAtZeroLift + CpMinPerCL CL), p_l = p(1 + 0.7 M^2 Cp_min); lex: alpha > LexAlphaOnsetDeg, Cp = -LexCpPerDeg (alpha - onset); cone: ConeMachMin <= M <= ConeMachMax, T_l/T = (1+0.2M^2)/(1+0.2 ConeLocalMach^2), p_l/p = (T_l/T)^3.5, ending at the recompression shock.
